references.label: Red Circle club
references.description: The Red Circle target area and VIP plunge lane occupy the upper-left playfield.

references.label: John Wick car
references.description: The motorized car bash toy sits in the center-left playfield.

references.label: WINSTON captive ball
references.description: The WINSTON captive ball is inside the Continental structure in the upper-middle playfield.

references.label: Weapons crate and VUK
references.description: The weapons crate opens to expose the Job-start VUK in the right-center playfield.

references.label: Left eject and battle cashout
references.description: The left eject starts battles and collects Job and battle cashouts.

references.label: Center ramp and Deconsecrated locks
references.description: The center ramp locks balls for Deconsecrated Multiball.

references.label: Left orbit and Car Multiball start
references.description: The left orbit starts a qualified Car Multiball and can return quickly.

references.label: Katia right ramp
references.description: The right ramp collects Katia and returns by wireform toward the right flipper.
